WITH pair_state AS (
  SELECT
    p.id AS pair_id,
    p.mentee_name,
    p.mentee_email,
    p.mentor_name,
    p.mentor_email,
    p.cohort_start_date,
    GREATEST(1, LEAST(52, (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) + 1)) AS current_week,
    CASE
      WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 13 THEN 1
      WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 26 THEN 2
      WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 39 THEN 3
      ELSE 4
    END AS current_quarter
  FROM table_2 p
  WHERE p.pair_status = 'active'
    AND p.mentor_email IS NOT NULL
    AND p.mentor_email != ''
    AND p.cohort_start_date <= NOW()
)
SELECT
  ps.pair_id,
  ps.mentee_name,
  ps.mentee_email,
  ps.mentor_name,
  ps.mentor_email,
  ps.cohort_start_date,
  ps.current_week,
  ps.current_quarter,
  qc.id AS cycle_id,
  qc.created_at AS cycle_created_at,
  COALESCE(qc.status, 'no_cycle') AS cycle_status,
  COALESCE(qc.meeting_confirmed_mentee, FALSE) AS confirmed_mentee,
  COALESCE(qc.meeting_confirmed_mentor, FALSE) AS confirmed_mentor,

  COALESCE(cp1.mentee_completed, FALSE) AS cp1_mentee_completed,
  COALESCE(cp1.mentor_completed, FALSE) AS cp1_mentor_completed,
  COALESCE(cp2.mentee_completed, FALSE) AS cp2_mentee_completed,
  COALESCE(cp2.mentor_completed, FALSE) AS cp2_mentor_completed,

  cp1.created_at AS cp1_opened_at,
  cp2.created_at AS cp2_row_created_at,
  cp1.mentee_completed_at AS cp1_mentee_completed_at,
  cp1.mentor_completed_at AS cp1_mentor_completed_at,

  COALESCE((
    SELECT COUNT(*) > 0
    FROM table_3 g
    WHERE g.pair_id = ps.pair_id
      AND g.quarter = ps.current_quarter
      AND g.submitted_by = 'mentee'
  ), FALSE) AS mentee_goals_submitted,

  COALESCE((
    SELECT COUNT(*) > 0
    FROM table_3 g
    WHERE g.pair_id = ps.pair_id
      AND g.quarter = ps.current_quarter
      AND g.submitted_by = 'mentor'
  ), FALSE) AS mentor_goals_submitted,

  COALESCE((
    SELECT f.submitted_at IS NOT NULL
    FROM table_4 f
    WHERE f.cycle_id = qc.id
      AND f.submitted_by = 'mentee'
    LIMIT 1
  ), FALSE) AS mentee_feedback_submitted,

  COALESCE((
    SELECT f.submitted_at IS NOT NULL
    FROM table_4 f
    WHERE f.cycle_id = qc.id
      AND f.submitted_by = 'mentor'
    LIMIT 1
  ), FALSE) AS mentor_feedback_submitted

FROM table_5 ps
LEFT JOIN table_6 qc
  ON qc.pair_id = ps.pair_id
 AND qc.quarter = ps.current_quarter
LEFT JOIN table_7 cp1
  ON cp1.cycle_id = qc.id
 AND cp1.checkpoint_no = 1
LEFT JOIN table_7 cp2
  ON cp2.cycle_id = qc.id
 AND cp2.checkpoint_no = 2;

INSERT INTO table_6 (pair_id, quarter, cycle_start_date, status)
VALUES ($1::UUID, $2, NOW()::DATE, 'pending')
ON CONFLICT (pair_id, quarter) DO UPDATE
  column_1 NOW();

INSERT INTO table_7 (pair_id, cycle_id, quarter, checkpoint_no, status)
SELECT qc.pair_id, qc.id, qc.quarter, c.checkpoint_no, 'pending'
FROM table_6 qc
CROSS JOIN (VALUES (1), (2)) AS c(checkpoint_no)
WHERE qc.pair_id = $1::UUID
  AND qc.quarter = $2::INT
ON CONFLICT (cycle_id, checkpoint_no) DO NOTHING;

SELECT id AS cycle_id, pair_id
FROM table_6
column_2 $1::UUID
  column_3 $2::INT;

-- Link pre-captured mentee Q1 goals to the created cycle before issuing tokens
UPDATE table_3
column_4 $3::UUID
column_2 $2::UUID
  column_5 'mentee'
  column_3 1
  AND cycle_id IS NULL;

-- Mark checkpoint 1 mentee side complete if Q1 mentee goals already exist
UPDATE table_7 c
column_6 TRUE,
  mentee_completed_at = COALESCE(c.mentee_completed_at, NOW()),
  status = CASE WHEN c.mentor_completed THEN 'completed' ELSE 'in_progress' END,
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE c.cycle_id = $3::UUID
  AND c.checkpoint_no = 1
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM table_3 g
    WHERE g.pair_id = $2::UUID
      AND g.submitted_by = 'mentee'
      AND g.quarter = 1
  );

-- Invalidate any prior unused goal tokens for this checkpoint before inserting new ones
UPDATE table_10
column_7 TRUE
column_2 $2::UUID
  column_4 $3::UUID
  column_8 $8::INT
  column_9 'goal_submission'
  column_7 FALSE;

INSERT INTO table_10 (token, pair_id, cycle_id, checkpoint_no, person_email, person_role, token_type, expires_at)
SELECT $1, $2::UUID, $3::UUID, $8::INT, $4, 'mentee', 'goal_submission', $5::TIMESTAMPTZ
WHERE $1 IS NOT NULL
ON CONFLICT (token) DO NOTHING;

SELECT $6, $2::UUID, $3::UUID, $8::INT, $7, 'mentor', 'goal_submission', $5::TIMESTAMPTZ
WHERE $6 IS NOT NULL
ON CONFLICT (token) DO NOTHING;

SELECT
  t.pair_id,
  t.cycle_id,
  t.person_email,
  t.person_role,
  t.used,
  t.expires_at,
  p.mentee_name,
  p.mentor_name,
  p.mentee_email,
  p.mentor_email,
  qc.quarter,
  f.ai_questions,
  f.id AS feedback_id,

  -- Determine form type from table_14 and role
  CASE
    WHEN qc.quarter = 1 THEN 'q1'
    WHEN qc.quarter IN (2, 3) THEN 'q2q3'
    WHEN qc.quarter = 4 THEN 'q4'
  END AS feedback_type,

  -- Outstanding goals — only relevant for mentee in Q2/Q3/Q4
  -- Pull goals that have NOT been completed in any previous quarter
  CASE
    WHEN t.person_role = 'mentee' AND qc.quarter > 1 THEN (
      SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('index', g.goal_index, 'text', g.goal_text))
      FROM (
        SELECT 1 AS goal_index, g.goal_1 AS goal_text
        FROM table_3 g
        WHERE g.pair_id = t.pair_id AND g.submitted_by = 'mentee'
          AND g.goal_1 IS NOT NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM table_13 gc
            WHERE gc.pair_id = t.pair_id AND gc.goal_index = 1
          )
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 2, g.goal_2
        FROM table_3 g
        WHERE g.pair_id = t.pair_id AND g.submitted_by = 'mentee'
          AND g.goal_2 IS NOT NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM table_13 gc
            WHERE gc.pair_id = t.pair_id AND gc.goal_index = 2
          )
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 3, g.goal_3
        FROM table_3 g
        WHERE g.pair_id = t.pair_id AND g.submitted_by = 'mentee'
          AND g.goal_3 IS NOT NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM table_13 gc
            WHERE gc.pair_id = t.pair_id AND gc.goal_index = 3
          )
      ) g
    )
    ELSE NULL
  END AS outstanding_goals

FROM table_10 t
JOIN table_2 p ON p.id = t.pair_id
JOIN table_6 qc ON qc.id = t.cycle_id
JOIN table_4 f

  AND t.used = FALSE 
  AND t.token_type = 'feedback_submission'

WITH token_ctx AS (
  SELECT
    t.token,
    t.token_type,
    md.email AS mentee_email,
    md.name AS mentee_name,
    md.cohort_name
  FROM table_10 t
  JOIN table_17 md ON md.email = t.person_email
  WHERE t.token = $8

), existing_pair AS (
  SELECT p.id AS pair_id, p.mentor_email AS old_mentor_email
  FROM table_2 p
  JOIN table_19 tc ON tc.mentee_email = p.mentee_email AND tc.cohort_name = p.cohort_name
  LIMIT 1
), upsert_pair AS (
  INSERT INTO table_2
    (mentee_name, mentee_email, mentor_name, mentor_email, cohort_start_date, cohort_name, pair_status)
  SELECT
    md.name,
    md.email,
    mp.name,
    mp.email,
    c.start_date,
    $3,
    'pending'
  FROM table_17 md
  CROSS JOIN table_16 mp
  CROSS JOIN table_18 c
  WHERE md.email = $1
    AND mp.email = $2
    AND c.cohort_name = $3
  ON CONFLICT (mentee_email) DO UPDATE
    column_23 EXCLUDED.mentor_name,
        mentor_email = EXCLUDED.mentor_email,
        cohort_name = EXCLUDED.cohort_name,
        pair_status = CASE WHEN HR_MentorMe_Pairs.pair_status = 'reassigning' THEN 'active' ELSE HR_MentorMe_Pairs.pair_status END

-- ### Key Schema Design Notes

-- `HR_MentorMe_Pairs.status` vs `pair_status`:** The `status` column is a legacy field that always equals `'active'`. The operative status is `pair_status` (`pending | active | reassigning | completed`). All queries should filter on `pair_status`.

SELECT
  p.id                          AS pair_id,
  p.mentee_name,
  p.mentee_email,
  p.mentor_name,
  p.mentor_email,
  p.cohort_name,
  p.pair_status,
  p.cohort_start_date,

  -- Current quarter/week
  GREATEST(1, LEAST(52, (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) + 1)) AS current_week,
  CASE
    WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 13 THEN 1
    WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 26 THEN 2
    WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 39 THEN 3
    ELSE 4
  END                           AS current_quarter,

  -- Current quarter cycle
  qc.id                         AS cycle_id,
  qc.status                     AS cycle_status,
  qc.meeting_confirmed_mentee,
  qc.meeting_confirmed_mentor,
  qc.meeting_confirmed_at,

  -- Escalations (all time)
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_31 e
   WHERE e.pair_id = p.id)      AS escalation_count,

  -- Goals: mentee goals text (most recent quarter)
  (SELECT json_build_object(
    'goal_1', g.goal_1,
    'goal_2', g.goal_2,
    'goal_3', g.goal_3,
    'additional_context', g.additional_context,
    'quarter', g.quarter,
    'submitted_at', g.submitted_at
  ) FROM table_3 g
  WHERE g.pair_id = p.id AND g.submitted_by = 'mentee'
  ORDER BY g.quarter DESC LIMIT 1) AS mentee_goal,

  -- Goals: mentor support plan text (most recent quarter)
  (SELECT json_build_object(
    'additional_context', g.additional_context,
    'quarter', g.quarter,
    'submitted_at', g.submitted_at
  ) FROM table_3 g
  WHERE g.pair_id = p.id AND g.submitted_by = 'mentor'
  ORDER BY g.quarter DESC LIMIT 1) AS mentor_support_plan,

  -- Goals submitted counts
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_3 g
   WHERE g.pair_id = p.id AND g.submitted_by = 'mentee') AS mentee_goals_quarters_submitted,

  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_3 g
   WHERE g.pair_id = p.id AND g.submitted_by = 'mentor') AS mentor_support_plans_submitted,

  -- Goal completions (all time)
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_13 gc
   WHERE gc.pair_id = p.id)     AS goals_completed_count,

  (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('quarter', gc.quarter, 'goal_index', gc.goal_index))
   FROM table_13 gc
   WHERE gc.pair_id = p.id)     AS goals_completed_detail,

  -- Feedback: all submissions across all quarters
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_4 f
   WHERE f.pair_id = p.id AND f.submitted_at IS NOT NULL) AS feedback_submitted_total,

  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_4 f
   WHERE f.pair_id = p.id AND f.submitted_by = 'mentee' AND f.submitted_at IS NOT NULL) AS mentee_feedback_count,

  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_4 f
   WHERE f.pair_id = p.id AND f.submitted_by = 'mentor' AND f.submitted_at IS NOT NULL) AS mentor_feedback_count,

  -- Learning logs submitted (mentee only)
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_4 f
   WHERE f.pair_id = p.id AND f.submitted_by = 'mentee'
   AND f.learning_log IS NOT NULL AND f.learning_log != '') AS learning_logs_count,

  -- Q4 mentor review submitted
  (SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM table_4 f
   WHERE f.pair_id = p.id AND f.submitted_by = 'mentor'
   AND f.quarter = 4 AND f.submitted_at IS NOT NULL) AS mentor_q4_review_submitted,

  -- Per-quarter cycle summary (all 4 quarters)
  (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    'quarter', qall.quarter,
    'status', qall.status,
    'meeting_confirmed_mentee', qall.meeting_confirmed_mentee,
    'meeting_confirmed_mentor', qall.meeting_confirmed_mentor,
    'meeting_confirmed_at', qall.meeting_confirmed_at
  ) ORDER BY qall.quarter)
  FROM table_6 qall
  WHERE qall.pair_id = p.id)    AS all_cycles,

  -- Last activity (latest of any submission)
  GREATEST(
    (SELECT MAX(g.submitted_at) FROM table_3 g WHERE g.pair_id = p.id),
    (SELECT MAX(f.submitted_at) FROM table_4 f WHERE f.pair_id = p.id AND f.submitted_at IS NOT NULL),
    qc.meeting_confirmed_at
  )                             AS last_activity_at,

  -- End of quarter flag (current cycle unconfirmed with ≤2 weeks left)
  CASE
    WHEN (
      (qc.status IS NULL OR qc.status = 'pending')
      AND (
        CASE
          WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 13 THEN 13
          WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 26 THEN 26
          WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 39 THEN 39
          ELSE 52
        END - GREATEST(1, (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) + 1)
      ) <= 2
    ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
  END                           AS end_of_quarter_flag

FROM table_2 p
LEFT JOIN table_6 qc
  ON qc.pair_id = p.id
  AND qc.quarter = CASE
    WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 13 THEN 1
    WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 26 THEN 2
    WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 39 THEN 3
    ELSE 4
  END
WHERE p.pair_status IN ('active', 'pending', 'reassigning')
  AND p.cohort_start_date <= NOW()
ORDER BY p.cohort_name ASC, p.mentee_name ASC;

-- Dashboard metrics
SELECT
  'metrics' AS query_type,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_2 column_27 'active') AS active_pairs,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_2 column_27 'pending') AS pending_pairs,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_2 column_27 'reassigning') AS reassigning_pairs,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_2 column_27 'completed') AS completed_pairs,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT mentor_email) FROM table_2 column_27 'active') AS active_mentors,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_6 column_18 'confirmed' column_18 'feedback_sent') AS meetings_confirmed,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_6 column_18 'escalated') AS escalations,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_4 WHERE submitted_at IS NOT NULL) AS feedback_submitted,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_3) AS goals_submitted,
  (SELECT cohort_name FROM table_18 column_18 'pending' ORDER BY start_date ASC LIMIT 1) AS next_cohort_name,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_2 column_27 'pending') AS next_cohort_pending_pairs;

SELECT
  mp.email,
  mp.name,
  mp.department,
  mp.location,
  mp.role,
  mp.is_active,
  mp.profile_submitted,
  mp.cohort_mentee_count,
  mp.personal_statement,
  -- How many active pairs this mentor currently has
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_2 p
   WHERE p.mentor_email = mp.email
     AND p.pair_status IN ('active','pending','reassigning')) AS paired_mentee_count,
  -- Total escalations across all their mentees
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sub.esc),0) FROM (
    SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_31 e WHERE e.pair_id = p2.id) AS esc
    FROM table_2 p2
    WHERE p2.mentor_email = mp.email
      AND p2.pair_status IN ('active','pending','reassigning')
  ) sub) AS total_escalations,
  -- Meetings confirmed this quarter across their mentees
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_2 p
   JOIN table_6 qc ON qc.pair_id = p.id
     AND qc.quarter = CASE
       WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 13 THEN 1
       WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 26 THEN 2
       WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 39 THEN 3
       ELSE 4 END
   WHERE p.mentor_email = mp.email
     AND p.pair_status IN ('active','pending','reassigning')
     AND qc.meeting_confirmed_mentor = TRUE) AS meetings_confirmed,
  -- Support plans submitted
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_3 g
   JOIN table_2 p ON p.id = g.pair_id
   WHERE p.mentor_email = mp.email
     AND g.submitted_by = 'mentor') AS support_plans_submitted,
  -- Q4 reviews submitted
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_4 f
   JOIN table_2 p ON p.id = f.pair_id
   WHERE p.mentor_email = mp.email
     AND f.submitted_by = 'mentor'
     AND f.quarter = 4
     AND f.submitted_at IS NOT NULL) AS q4_reviews_submitted
FROM table_16 mp
WHERE mp.is_active = TRUE
ORDER BY mp.name ASC;

SELECT
  md.email,
  md.name,
  md.department,
  md.location,
  md.role,
  md.cohort_name,
  md.status                         AS directory_status,
  -- Pair info (null if not paired)
  p.id                              AS pair_id,
  p.mentor_name,
  p.mentor_email,
  p.pair_status,
  p.cohort_start_date,
  CASE WHEN p.id IS NOT NULL THEN
    GREATEST(1, LEAST(52, (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) + 1))
  END                               AS current_week,
  CASE WHEN p.id IS NOT NULL THEN
    CASE
      WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 13 THEN 1
      WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 26 THEN 2
      WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 39 THEN 3
      ELSE 4
    END
  END                               AS current_quarter,
  qc.status                         AS cycle_status,
  qc.meeting_confirmed_mentee,
  qc.meeting_confirmed_mentor,
  qc.meeting_confirmed_at,
  -- Escalations
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_31 e
   WHERE e.pair_id = p.id), 0)      AS escalation_count,
  -- Goals
  (SELECT json_build_object(
    'goal_1', g.goal_1, 'goal_2', g.goal_2, 'goal_3', g.goal_3,
    'additional_context', g.additional_context,
    'quarter', g.quarter
  ) FROM table_3 g
  WHERE g.pair_id = p.id AND g.submitted_by = 'mentee'
  ORDER BY g.quarter DESC LIMIT 1)  AS mentee_goal,
  -- Support plan
  (SELECT json_build_object(
    'additional_context', g.additional_context,
    'quarter', g.quarter
  ) FROM table_3 g
  WHERE g.pair_id = p.id AND g.submitted_by = 'mentor'
  ORDER BY g.quarter DESC LIMIT 1)  AS mentor_support_plan,
  -- Goal completions
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_13 gc
   WHERE gc.pair_id = p.id), 0)     AS goals_completed_count,
  (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('quarter', gc.quarter, 'goal_index', gc.goal_index))
   FROM table_13 gc
   WHERE gc.pair_id = p.id)         AS goals_completed_detail,
  -- Feedback
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_4 f
   WHERE f.pair_id = p.id AND f.submitted_by = 'mentee'
   AND f.submitted_at IS NOT NULL), 0) AS mentee_feedback_count,
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_4 f
   WHERE f.pair_id = p.id AND f.submitted_by = 'mentee'
   AND f.learning_log IS NOT NULL AND f.learning_log != ''), 0) AS learning_logs_count,
  -- All cycles
  (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    'quarter', qall.quarter, 'status', qall.status,
    'meeting_confirmed_mentee', qall.meeting_confirmed_mentee,
    'meeting_confirmed_mentor', qall.meeting_confirmed_mentor,
    'meeting_confirmed_at', qall.meeting_confirmed_at
  ) ORDER BY qall.quarter)
  FROM table_6 qall
  WHERE qall.pair_id = p.id)        AS all_cycles,
  -- Last activity
  GREATEST(
    (SELECT MAX(g.submitted_at) FROM table_3 g WHERE g.pair_id = p.id),
    (SELECT MAX(f.submitted_at) FROM table_4 f WHERE f.pair_id = p.id AND f.submitted_at IS NOT NULL),
    qc.meeting_confirmed_at
  )                                 AS last_activity_at
FROM table_17 md
LEFT JOIN table_2 p
  ON p.mentee_email = md.email
  AND p.pair_status IN ('active','pending','reassigning')
LEFT JOIN table_6 qc
  ON qc.pair_id = p.id
  AND qc.quarter = CASE
    WHEN p.id IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 13 THEN 1
    WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 26 THEN 2
    WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 39 THEN 3
    ELSE 4
  END
WHERE md.status NOT IN ('graduated','exited')
ORDER BY md.name ASC;

    p.id AS pair_id,
    p.mentee_email
  FROM table_21 r
  JOIN table_2 p ON p.id = r.pair_id
  WHERE r.id = $1::UUID
    AND r.resolved_at IS NULL
), update_pair AS (
  UPDATE table_2 p
  column_40 ag.returning_mentor_email,
      mentor_name  = mp.name,
      pair_status  = 'active'
  FROM table_41 ag
  JOIN table_16 mp ON mp.email = ag.returning_mentor_email
  WHERE p.id = ag.pair_id
  RETURNING p.id AS pair_id
), inc_mentor AS (
  UPDATE table_16 mp
  column_22 cohort_mentee_count + 1,
      updated_at = NOW()
  FROM table_41 ag
  WHERE mp.email = ag.returning_mentor_email
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM table_42)
), restore_mentee AS (
  UPDATE table_17 md
  column_18 'paired',
      updated_at = NOW()
  FROM table_41 ag
  WHERE md.email = ag.mentee_email
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM table_42)
), reset_checkpoint_clock AS (
  UPDATE table_7 cp
  column_24 NOW(),
      updated_at = NOW()
  FROM table_42 up
  WHERE cp.pair_id = up.pair_id
    AND cp.status  = 'pending'
), resolve_reassignment AS (
  UPDATE table_21
  column_18 'resolved',
      mentee_decision = 'accept_return',

      updated_at      = NOW()

  FROM table_41 ag
  WHERE t.pair_id   = ag.pair_id

      '[ID]'
    )
    AND t.used = FALSE
)
